query_compiler.sampling: rank original rows by SHA-256(dataset name, feature vector) with original row index as the duplicate-feature tie-break; labels excluded
query_compiler.numeric_detection: all nonmissing tokens parse as finite Decimal
query_compiler.quantile_rank_rule: ceil(k*n/8)-1 on sorted nonmissing sampled values

protocol.state_selector: v0.84 selector unchanged for contributing tasks; complete-query functional-dependency closure is used only when v0.84 yields zero states
protocol.record_sampler: v0.70 feature-only SHA-256 sampler; labels excluded
protocol.response_lattice_closure: joint generator partition refines each determined query partition

pmlb_cross_source_adapter.raw_verification: raw gzip byte length and SHA-256 must match the v0.81 lock before decompression
pmlb_cross_source_adapter.decompression: Python standard-library gzip.decompress only after successful raw-byte verification
pmlb_cross_source_adapter.table_parser: Python standard-library csv.reader with tab delimiter; no dataframe library
pmlb_cross_source_adapter.header: one unique nonempty header row; exact target column name target; all other columns in declared table order are features
pmlb_cross_source_adapter.shape: record count equals frozen instances and feature-column count equals frozen features
pmlb_cross_source_adapter.values: missing feature cells become the empty token; other cells are stripped strings; target cells must be nonempty
pmlb_cross_source_adapter.sparse_or_malformed_rows: reject rows whose column count differs from the header
